title: The First 48
description:
S17 E26 — Snapshot
A young mother in Tulsa, Okla., is found shot dead on the side of a road; a photograph taken immediately before the murder provides police with their only clue.

title: The First 48
description:
S17 E28 — Sudden Death; Devil at the Door
A New Orleans detective battles fear and distrust on the street as he works the case of a man who was executed in broad daylight; a Minneapolis man witnesses the murder of his teenage son.

title: The First 48
description:
S17 E14 — The Case That Haunts Me 1
Veteran homicide Lt. Rick Zimmerman recalls the case of a woman and two young boys who were tortured before being brutally murdered.

title: The First 48
description:
S18 E08 — Deadly Favor; Just Kids
An elderly New Orleans man is shot dead outside his home; Atlanta police work to identify the young man and woman caught on a store camera committing a murder in broad daylight.

title: The First 48
description:
S19 E16 — Inside the Tape Special No. 7
Detectives have doubts when a star witness identifies her boyfriend's killers; a detective tries to get a friend of two murdered men to change his ways; a man is randomly shot in front of his sister's house; a homeless man is brutally murdered.

title: The First 48: Playing With Fire
description:
S01 E11 — Insider; Pointless
In Charlotte, N.C., a rookie detective gets her first double murder: a young couple shot in their car by a backseat passenger; a woman is shot to death and then set on fire in Birmingham, Ala.; includes bonus footage.

description:
S19 E27 — Knock at the Door; The Brave One
